title: First working windshield wiper patented
summary: Mary Anderson patented a hand-operated blade device to clear snow, ice and sleet from the windshields of electric cars and other vehicles.
why: The blueprint for every modern windshield wiper.

unsung.contribution: Invented and patented the first operational windshield wiper.
unsung.recognition: Her patent expired in 1920 without mass production; its impact only became clear in retrospect.
